people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: If we should say, ‘From men’ ”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.
translations.bsb: But if we say, ‘From men’...” they were afraid of the people, for they all held that John truly was a prophet.
translations.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
translations.asv: But should we say, From men--they feared the people: for all verily held John to be a prophet.
